findings_for_later_tasks.finding: Token-category inclusion is untested: upstream_client.py:831-856 maps cached_tokens from prompt_tokens_details and reasoning_tokens from completion_tokens_details, but no test or document pins cached as a subset of input or reasoning as a subset of output. Under plan v2 design 5, B1 treats the overlap as unavailable until a test pins it from a cited source.

No capture feature negotiation exists. An older Gateway answers a new record kind with 400 CAPTURE_KIND (usage_capture.py:148); the host maps it to a non-transient DrainStop('refused:400') (capture_delivery.py:35), which stalls the whole stream. Emitting turn.report_context needs a capability check first.

Cache-write tokens are not captured anywhere (ProviderMessageResult, capture contract). Reference prices for cache writes (5m and 1h) cannot be applied; the report must state that portion as unavailable, never priced at zero or at the input price.

Reference price schedules have long-context tiers (overrides keyed by min_prompt_tokens) and per-request web_search prices in the dated source. The reference schema needs per-request tier selection by reported input tokens; a tier the schema cannot express makes the affected requests unavailable.

No post-setup notification hook exists: notifications sent inside _handle_session_new go out before the response. available_commands_update must be sent after server.py deliver_envelope (:1439) for a successful session/new (zed-industries/zed#60199). session/load is not implemented, so only session/new needs it.
_handle_post reads and parses the body before authenticating (server.py:143-157). The new report route needs the capture route's pre-body auth branch (server.py:140, _handle_capture :206-229).

The zero-paid Zed path reuses the #397 scripted stub (optimus-handoff/p397-stub/stub_provider.py, sha256 hex:23f10cd865db15951483fb493acae5fa1f226cd8b57cdf4a8573da43f6f494ad; contract S2 in its plan r6), which returns fixed usage with cost 0. The savings UI cases need scenario-driven synthetic usage (nonzero cost, cached tokens) labelled synthetic. Normal launch runs non-strict preflight (bootstrap.py:126) with no model call; strict preflight (preflight.py:228) bills and stays off.

Current HLD v2.23, LLD v2.46 and Test Strategy v1.9 have no conflict with the plan but are stale or silent: the Gateway ledger is described as Redis (HLD p11/p14, LLD p39), the closed route list lacks the new route (LLD p2/p4/p6), there is no ACP command section and no Postgres test tier (TS p3). Delivery needs a governed documentation successor (ADR-005 consequence), drafted by Codex.

Constraints to carry: price snapshots are diagnostic only and never overwrite provider-reported cost (LLD p38-40); non-registry reference prices must never feed registry price ordering or eligibility (HLD p18); test profiles do not read operator overrides (HLD p18); a deselected Postgres or Zed tier is UNRUN, not a pass (TS p16).
